caption:
Mistral AI has unveiled Leanstral 1.5, an open-source model designed for formal verification in programming. The model achieved a perfect score on miniF2F and solved 587 out of 672 problems on the PutnamBench. It's been effective in identifying bugs in existing code as well. ⚙️

Could this model change the landscape of code verification?

Sources: The Decoder, Mistral AI
